runtimeFlags: 3-stage layer pipeline (qwen35 engine), one stage per NUC iGPU (19/23/23 GB), 2.5 GbE, --gpu-keepalive-ms 2, greedy, batch 1; Windows GPU shared-memory window 85% on every node
notes: Three ASUS NUCs (Core Ultra X7 358H, Arc B390 iGPU, 32 GB each, Windows 11) on one 2.5 GbE switch. OpenVINO IR built from Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-GPTQ-Int4 with the builder's signed-INT4 expert layout (64 GB total), split 16/16/16 layers across the three iGPUs. decodeTps is the medium prompt (975 tokens after the chat template, 256 generated, temperature 0, thinking off) averaged over 3 timed repeats after 1 warm-up: (completion tokens - 1) / (request wall time - time to first token), with TTFT from a separate max_tokens=1 request; ttftMs is that prompt's median. Short (31-token) prompt 10.5 tok/s; 7.7k-token prompt 10.1 tok/s with 36.9 s to first token; 90 s steady loop 10.5 tok/s. The keep-alive only changes per-token latency: with it off the same chain decodes at about 3 tok/s because the idle iGPU is charged ~0.5 s on 40-50% of steps; outputs identical to the stock 0.2.7 build on 8/8 parity prompts. GSM8K 20-question subset: 17/20.
